pages.text: Gold ingots in the corners, a redstone block above, Constructors on the left and right, a Mk.2 belt in the center, and iron bars below.

pages.title: Two Ingredients
pages.text: The Assembler crafts recipes using $(thing)one or two item types$(), including torches and most tools.$(br2)It also handles Constructor recipes. Recipes requiring three or more item types are excluded.

pages.title: Choose a Recipe
pages.text: Use the ghost $(thing)Template$() slot just like a Constructor: click with the desired output or drag it from JEI. No item is consumed.$(br2)Click a recipe row to select an alternative. Scroll to see more choices. Actual recipe quantities are preserved.

pages.title: Supply Ingredients
pages.text: Two ingredient buffers share all non-output faces. Three horizontal belts can feed them together; RF uses the same faces.$(br2)Each item type occupies one slot, capped at twice its recipe quantity. Crafting immediately frees room for more. The dropper face is the output.

pages.title: Power and Output
pages.text: Each complete $(thing)craft$() costs $(thing)1,000 RF$(), with a $(thing)10,000 RF$() buffer and no per-tick intake limit.$(br2)For example, 1 coal + 1 stick makes 4 torches for 1,000 RF total. Crafting is instant when ingredients, power, and output space are available.

pages.title: Safe Buffering
pages.text: Blocked outputs preserve ingredients and power. Completed results and crafting remainders wait safely for output space.$(br2)Changing recipes preserves stored items. Remove leftover ingredients from the two inventory slots if they do not fit the new recipe.
